acceptance_limitation: Cannot certify a leak-free as-known benchmark until original price availability/revision evidence exists.

capital_accounting.rule: Explicit initial equity, cash, collateral, realized/unrealized PnL, funding and borrow; no implicit leverage.

execution_delay.rule: Strictly after decision and actual observable receipt; no fill at signal candle close.

fees.rule: Actual venue/product/account schedule at entry and exit, including funding/borrow if applicable; never assume zero.

position_sizing.rule: Freeze notional, per-name and total exposure caps before strategy research; no sizing in baseline metrics.

slippage.rule: Measured size-dependent adverse execution; stress scenarios frozen before strategy evaluation.

spread.rule: Measured executable bid/ask on both legs; unavailable depth prevents execution claims.

trade_rejection.rule: Reject stale, closed, unavailable, insufficient-liquidity, permission or balance failures; count all.

decision.reason: Fixed one-hour operational lead; independent of observed errors; completed hourly bars only.

diagnostic_permission.assumption: Archived raw price revisions stand in for contemporaneous values; original availability is NOT proven. No model feature export; not BACKTESTED or final evidence.

calendar_schedule.condition: Scheduled calendar only; not realized halts.

source_session_evidence.condition: Explicit symbol scope, publication <= decision, effective range; UNKNOWN excluded.

final_oos_guard: No FINAL_OOS support in v1 CLI or library; future separately reviewed runner required.
missing_policy: No interpolation or synthetic prices. Missing exact anchor disables transfer/blend; missing decision mark disables mark/transfer/blend. Missing native boundary disables all. Unknown source segments disable Reality candidates. All-symbol scope and common-sample comparison.

parameters.mark_currency_assumption: 1 USDT = 1 USD; ESTIMATED, unverified conversion; mark is candle close, not executable quote
parameters.staleness_exclusion_policy: TBD; measure age; do not optimize. Never select before previous cash close or across source UNKNOWN/CLOSED.

split_assignment: Decision and target minute completion must both be inside partition; purge cross-boundary outcomes; no fitting in v1.
